These quantities are not confidence intervals, a combined significance, or bounds on omitted cutoff powers and infinite volume.

statements.text: The conditional crossover is 161.13 GeV. Its linearized statistical SD lies in [0.118, 0.137] GeV if separately simulated run sets are independent; allowing all cross-set covariance gives [0.000, 0.276] GeV. The paired reference-peak covariance is unretained. The one-percent reduction allowance 1.611 GeV and matched-volume cutoff sensitivity 0.349 GeV are separate. These quantities are not confidence intervals, a combined significance, or bounds on omitted cutoff powers and infinite volume.
statements.label: MEASURED

statements.text: The chain's point has x = 0.296. The first-order line ends at x = 0.0983(15).
statements.label: IMPORTED

statements.text: At x = 0.036 the transition is first order: two-peak histograms, hysteresis, and a susceptibility maximum that grows from 62 on 8^3 to 342 on 16^3 (exponent 2.9, volume scaling is 3).
statements.label: MEASURED

statements.text: At the chain's point the maximum stays finite: 3.41 on 16^3, 3.74 on 24^3, 3.83 on 32^3.
statements.label: MEASURED

statements.text: Growth of the maximum between 16^3 and 24^3 places the end of the first-order signal between x = 0.064 and x = 0.115 at this lattice spacing.
statements.label: MEASURED

statements.text: With the chain's other inputs fixed, a Higgs mass below 72.5 GeV gives a first-order transition.
statements.label: IMPORTED

statements.text: Standard Model lattice value: 159.5 +- 1.5 GeV (D'Onofrio, Rummukainen 2016). The comparison is not blind.
statements.label: IMPORTED

statements.text: The same pipeline with Standard Model inputs puts the maximum at 159.04 GeV; the published value at equal lattice spacing is 158.94 GeV.
statements.label: MEASURED

statements.text: The chain's couplings are declared forms that fit. Their derivation is open.
statements.label: DECLARED

statements.text: Source as built with one doublet: crossover at 145.1 GeV if its quartic and top couplings equal the declared row's, at 149.3 GeV if its Higgs and top masses do. These masses are not derived.
statements.label: DECLARED

statements.text: The transition lies 9.0e-12 s after the start of the radiation era, 1.31e+32 ticks.
statements.label: IMPORTED

statements.text: The reduction to three dimensions is perturbative, of relative order g^4, with an accuracy of about one percent.
statements.label: IMPORTED
